meta.scope: Turkey Batch 6 — Defence and security densification: military expenditure, national defence policy framing, and NATO anchoring.

candidates.title: Defence and security expenditure statistics
candidates.publisher: Ministry of National Defence / Ministry of Treasury and Finance / SIPRI-aligned
candidates.description: Official and compiled statistics on defence and security spending. Recent budgets place total defence and security expenditure in the mid-to-high USD 20 billions range (roughly 2.3% of GDP in 2026 projections), with further planned increases. Includes Ministry of National Defence and related security allocations.
candidates.notes: Core defence-resource node. Rising nominal and real commitments under inflation and strategic pressures.

candidates.title: National defence and security policy framing
candidates.publisher: Ministry of National Defence / Ministry of Foreign Affairs / related
candidates.description: Official framing of Türkiye’s defence and security policy, emphasising territorial integrity, self-defence, comprehensive approaches to contemporary threats, and contributions to collective defence and crisis management. Continuously cited in strategic and foreign-policy analysis.
candidates.notes: Core policy-frame node for Turkish defence posture.

candidates.title: NATO membership and collective defence framing
candidates.description: Framing of NATO membership (since 1952) as the cornerstone of Türkiye’s defence and security policy. Continuously referenced in alliance, capability and regional security discussions.
candidates.notes: Highest-centrality alliance node for Turkish security architecture.

candidates.title: Turkey defence–security densification meta-node
candidates.publisher: Derived from MoND, fiscal and alliance sources
candidates.description: Meta-node binding defence and security expenditure, national defence policy framing, and NATO membership/collective defence framing into a coherent defence and security layer.
